title: HMRC ready reckoner: direct effects of illustrative tax changes
description: Every row of HMRC's June 2025 'Direct effects of illustrative tax changes' table, £m by fiscal year.
notes:
Verbatim labels and values from the ODS table (Spring Statement 2025 basis). 'Neg' (negligible: above zero but rounding to zero) is stored as 0 with is_negligible=True. HMRC: direct effects of small illustrative changes, including some behavioural responses but no wider macroeconomic effects; larger changes need not scale linearly. Sign conventions differ by row (see tax_measures.csv).
